C: Learn C programming fundamentals, pointers and memory management.
C++: Learn OOP, STL and competitive programming concepts.
Java: Learn OOP, collections, exception handling and Spring basics.
Python: Learn Python programming, OOP and popular libraries.
SQL: Practice queries, joins, subqueries and database design.
Git: Learn version control, branching, merging and Git workflows.
GitHub: Learn repositories, pull requests and collaboration workflows.
HTML: Learn semantic HTML and proper webpage structure.
CSS: Learn layouts, Flexbox, Grid and responsive design.
JavaScript: Learn DOM manipulation, ES6 and asynchronous programming.
React: Learn components, props, state and React hooks.
Pandas: Practice data cleaning, filtering, grouping and analysis.
NumPy: Learn arrays, numerical operations and data manipulation.
Matplotlib: Learn data visualization and different chart types.
Scikit-learn: Learn machine learning algorithms and model evaluation.
Machine Learning: Learn supervised, unsupervised learning and model evaluation.
MySQL: Learn relational database design, queries and optimization.
PostgreSQL: Learn advanced SQL and relational database concepts.
SQLite: Learn lightweight database management and SQL operations.
MongoDB: Learn NoSQL databases, collections and document-based data.
FastAPI: Learn REST APIs, request handling and backend development.
Docker: Learn containers, images and application deployment.
AWS: Learn cloud fundamentals, EC2, S3 and basic AWS services.
Linux: Learn Linux commands, file systems and server administration.
Networking: Learn TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS and basic network security.
